plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, points to a documentary film called Age of Disclosure, in which he says very senior people, up to the level of the director of national intelligence, the top US intelligence official, say something. According to Michels, they say the secret work on these craft was a joint effort between the Department of Energy, which runs America's nuclear science, and the CIA's science and technology branch. If true, it would mean the work was hidden inside two powerful agencies, away from normal oversight.
